# VideoClaw

> YouTube AI Summary, Transcript Search & Video Chat Workspace

VideoClaw turns any YouTube video into a searchable learning workspace. Paste a public YouTube link to generate an AI summary, search the full transcript, jump to exact timestamps, and ask follow-up questions without losing the original context.

## Features

- **YouTube AI Summary**: Generate structured takeaways from any YouTube video before watching the full recording.
- **Full Transcript Search**: Search the transcript by keyword, phrase, or question to find the right part of the video.
- **Jump to Exact Timestamps**: Open the matched moment instantly instead of scrubbing through the full recording.
- **ChatGPT-Style Follow-Up**: Ask deeper questions after reading the summary and keep answers tied to the same video.
- **Transcript Verification**: Review the surrounding transcript and matched clip to confirm what the speaker actually meant.
- **Subtitle Translation**: Translate subtitles into multiple languages for free.

## Use Cases

- **Students & Researchers**: Search lectures and interviews for specific claims, explanations, or examples.
- **Knowledge Workers**: Review webinars, market discussions, and interviews with transcript search and exact timestamps.
- **Creators & Podcast Learners**: Turn long conversations into a searchable workspace and extract key ideas.

## Pricing

- Video analysis: 2 credits per video (previously analyzed videos are free to revisit)
- AI Chat: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite costs 0.25 credits/msg, Gemini 2.5 Flash costs 0.5 credits/msg, GPT and Claude cost 2 credits/msg
- Subtitle translation: Free
